api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Orders: List Purchase Orders

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PONumber, SupplierId, Status, BuyerEmailAddress, CreationDate. Example: q=Status='OPEN' and BuyerEmailAddress='buyer@example.com'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, schedules, distributions, attachments
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in the result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of purchase orders. Filter by supplier, buyer, or status to scope results.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Orders: Get a Purchase Order

api_arguments.POHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the purchase order header.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, schedules, distributions, attachments, changes
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific purchase order, including line items, delivery schedules, and account distributions.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Orders: Create a Purchase Order

api_arguments.BuyingPartyName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the procurement business unit.
api_arguments.SupplierSiteId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the supplier site.
api_arguments.BuyerEmailAddress: [REQUIRED] string: Email of the buyer responsible for this PO.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: [REQUIRED] string: Currency code for the purchase order. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.ShipToLocationId: integer: Default ship-to location identifier for all lines.
api_arguments.NoteToSupplier: string: Notes or instructions sent to the supplier on the PO.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Array of PO line objects. Each line requires ItemDescription, Quantity, UOMCode, and UnitPrice. ItemNumber is optional for description-based lines.

functionality: Creates a new purchase order with header and line details. Supports both item-based and description-based lines.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Orders: Update a Purchase Order

api_arguments.POHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the purchase order to update.
api_arguments.NoteToSupplier: string: Updated note to the supplier.
api_arguments.Description: string: Updated description for the PO header.

functionality: Updates header-level attributes of an existing purchase order. Line-level changes require updating via the lines child resource.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Orders: Submit a Purchase Order for Approval

api_arguments.POHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the purchase order to submit.
api_arguments.Comments: string: Comments to include with the approval submission.

functionality: Submits a draft purchase order into the approval workflow.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Requisitions: List Purchase Requisitions

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports RequisitionNumber, Status, RequesterEmailAddress, CreationDate, OrganizationCode. Example: q=Status='APPROVED'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, attachments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of purchase requisitions. Filter by status, requester, or organization to scope results.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Purchase Requisitions: Create a Purchase Requisition

api_arguments.RequisitioningBUId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the requisitioning business unit.
api_arguments.RequesterEmailAddress: [REQUIRED] string: Email address of the person requesting the items.
api_arguments.Description: string: Description or title of the requisition.
api_arguments.NoteToApprover: string: Notes included with the approval request.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Array of requisition line objects. Each line requires LineTypeCode, ItemDescription, Quantity, UOMCode, UnitPrice, and CurrencyCode. ItemNumber is optional.

functionality: Creates a new purchase requisition for goods or services. Can trigger automatic sourcing into a purchase order upon approval.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Suppliers: List Suppliers

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports SupplierName, SupplierNumber, Status, TaxOrganizationType, SetId. Example: q=Status='Active'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: sites, contacts, bankAccounts, addresses, qualifications
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.
api_arguments.orderBy: string: Sort field and direction. Example: orderBy=SupplierName:asc

functionality: Retrieves a list of suppliers registered in Oracle Procurement. Supports expanding related resources like sites and contacts.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Suppliers: Get a Supplier

api_arguments.SupplierId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the supplier.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: sites, contacts, bankAccounts, addresses, qualifications, products
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific supplier including profile, classification, and associated sites.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Suppliers: Create a Supplier

api_arguments.SupplierName: [REQUIRED] string: Legal name of the supplier.
api_arguments.SupplierNumber: string: Unique supplier number. Auto-generated if not provided.
api_arguments.TaxOrganizationType: [REQUIRED] string: Tax classification of the supplier. Valid values: INDIVIDUAL, CORPORATION, PARTNERSHIP, GOVERNMENT.
api_arguments.TaxpayerIdentificationNumber: string: Tax identification number (TIN or EIN).
api_arguments.BusinessRelationship: [REQUIRED] string: Type of relationship. Valid values: Spend Authorized, Prospective.
api_arguments.ParentSupplierId: integer: Parent supplier identifier for subsidiary relationships.
api_arguments.OneTimeFlag: boolean: If true, marks this as a one-time supplier. Default is false.
api_arguments.HoldFlag: boolean: If true, places the supplier on procurement hold. Default is false.

functionality: Creates a new supplier record in Oracle Procurement. Supplier sites and contacts must be created separately.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Supplier Sites: List Supplier Sites

api_arguments.SupplierId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the supplier.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports SiteName, Status, PurchasingSiteFlag, PaySiteFlag, PrimarySiteFlag. Example: q=PurchasingSiteFlag='Y'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, bankAccounts
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves all sites associated with a supplier, including purchasing, pay, and RFQ sites.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Supplier Sites: Create a Supplier Site

api_arguments.SupplierId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the parent supplier.
api_arguments.SiteName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the supplier site.
api_arguments.ProcurementBUId: [REQUIRED] integer: Procurement business unit associated with this site.
api_arguments.AddressLine1: [REQUIRED] string: First line of the site address.
api_arguments.AddressLine2: string: Second line of the site address.
api_arguments.City: [REQUIRED] string: City of the site address.
api_arguments.State: string: State or province of the site address.
api_arguments.PostalCode: [REQUIRED] string: Postal or ZIP code of the site address.
api_arguments.Country: [REQUIRED] string: Country code of the site address. Example: 'US'.
api_arguments.PurchasingSiteFlag: string: Whether this is a purchasing site. Valid values: Y, N. Default: Y.
api_arguments.PaySiteFlag: string: Whether payments are made to this site. Valid values: Y, N. Default: N.
api_arguments.PrimaryPaySiteFlag: string: Whether this is the primary payment site. Valid values: Y, N. Default: N.
api_arguments.PaymentTerms: string: Payment terms code for this site. Example: 'NET30'.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: string: Currency for transactions with this site. Example: 'USD'.

functionality: Creates a new site for an existing supplier, defining the address, payment, and purchasing attributes.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Blanket Purchase Agreements: List Agreements

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports DocumentNumber, SupplierId, Status, StartDate, EndDate. Example: q=Status='ACTIVE' and SupplierId=300000001234567
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, controls, attachments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves blanket purchase agreements (BPAs) that establish pricing and terms with suppliers for a period without committing to quantities.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Blanket Purchase Agreements: Create a Blanket Purchase Agreement

api_arguments.BuyerEmailAddress: [REQUIRED] string: Email of the responsible buyer.
api_arguments.StartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Effective start date of the agreement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.EndDate: [REQUIRED] string: Expiration date of the agreement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.AgreementAmount: number: Total agreed-upon amount ceiling for the BPA.
api_arguments.NoteToSupplier: string: Notes sent to the supplier with the agreement.
api_arguments.lines: array: Agreement line objects. Each line includes ItemNumber or ItemDescription, UnitPrice, UOMCode, and optionally Quantity.

functionality: Creates a new blanket purchase agreement to pre-negotiate pricing and terms with a supplier for future purchase orders.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Negotiations: List Negotiations

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports DocumentNumber, Status, NegotiationType, BuyerEmailAddress, CloseDate. Example: q=Status='ACTIVE'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, suppliers, requirements
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves sourcing negotiations (RFQs, auctions, RFIs) created in Oracle Sourcing.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Invoices: List Payables Invoices

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports InvoiceNumber, SupplierId, Status, InvoiceDate, PONumber, BusinessUnitId. Example: q=Status='Unpaid' and SupplierId=300000001234567
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, payments, holds, attachments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves supplier invoices from Oracle Payables. Filter by supplier, status, or purchase order number.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Invoices: Create a Supplier Invoice

api_arguments.BusinessUnitName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the payables business unit.
api_arguments.InvoiceDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the invoice. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.InvoiceCurrencyCode: [REQUIRED] string: Currency code of the invoice. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.InvoiceType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of invoice. Valid values: Standard, Credit, Debit, Prepayment.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Invoice lines. Each line requires LineNumber, LineType, Amount, and either POHeaderId+POLineId for PO-matched lines or AccountingDate and ChargeAccountId for non-PO lines.

functionality: Creates a supplier invoice in Oracle Payables. Supports PO-matched and non-PO invoice lines.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Invoices: Validate and Submit an Invoice for Payment

api_arguments.InvoiceId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the invoice to validate.
api_arguments.AccountingDate: string: Accounting date to use during validation. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to system date.
api_arguments.CreateAccounting: boolean: If true, creates accounting entries during validation. Default is false.

functionality: Validates an invoice to check for holds and errors, making it eligible for payment processing.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Invoice Holds: List Invoice Holds

api_arguments.InvoiceId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the invoice.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports HoldName, HeldBy, HoldDate, ReleaseName. Example: q=ReleaseName is null to retrieve unreleased holds.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves holds placed on a supplier invoice that are preventing payment processing.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Payments: List Payments

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PaymentNumber, SupplierId, Status, PaymentDate, PaymentMethodCode, BusinessUnitId. Example: q=Status='Negotiable' and PaymentDate >= '2024-01-01'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: invoices, attachments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves supplier payment records from Oracle Payables. Supports filtering by supplier, payment date, and status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Spending Categories: List Spending Categories

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports CategoryName, CategoryCode, Status, SetId. Example: q=Status='Active'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves procurement spending categories used to classify purchased goods and services for spend analysis.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Procurement Agents: List Procurement Agents

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports AgentName, EmailAddress, ProcurementBUId, ActiveStatus. Example: q=ActiveStatus='Y'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: businessUnits, categories
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves procurement agents (buyers) and their associated business units and category assignments.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Approved Supplier Lists: List Approved Suppliers

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ItemId, ItemNumber, SupplierId, SupplierSiteId, Status, OrganizationCode. Example: q=ItemNumber='AS18947' and Status='Active'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: qualifications
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Date for which ASL records are effective. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves the Approved Supplier List (ASL) entries defining which suppliers are authorized to supply specific items.

api_name: REST API for Oracle Procurement Cloud - Supplier Qualifications: Get Supplier Qualification

api_arguments.QualificationId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the supplier qualification record.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: responses, assessments
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves details of a specific supplier qualification, including questionnaire responses and assessor evaluations.
